title: Loop+ Win-Back Goodwill Credit on Marketplace Orders Guarantee Grants
content:
**Rule.** The Loop+ win-back credit of the Marketplace Orders guarantee grant looks at the buyer's Loop+ membership on the decision date: a membership in lapsed status whose end date fell no more than the win-back window of 60 days before the decision date earns the lapsed win-back credit of USD 12.50; a membership in cancelled status whose end date fell within the same window earns the cancelled win-back credit of USD 5.00; any other buyer earns no win-back credit.

Each goodwill credit of the guarantee grant is decided on its own; it is added together with any other goodwill credit of the grant, and what is paid of the credits is added to the amount claimed.

The record read is the buyer's Loop+ Membership: its status on the decision date and its end date.

## Basis questions and answers

**Q. What does "no more than 60 days before the decision date" cover?**
A. An end date on or before the decision date, with 60 or fewer calendar days from the end date to the decision date.

**Q. Lapsed, ended 60 days before the decision date?**
A. USD 12.50. Ended 61 days before: nothing.

**Q. Cancelled, ended 30 days before the decision date?**
A. USD 5.00.

**Q. Active, in trial, on payment hold, cancel pending or pending?**
A. No win-back credit.

| Status on the decision date | End date within 60 days before the decision date | Credit (USD) |
|---|---|---|
| lapsed | yes | 12.50 |
| cancelled | yes | 5.00 |
| lapsed or cancelled | no | 0.00 |
| any other | — | 0.00 |
